entry.title: Sally Rooney's books will no longer be sold in U.K. after Palestinian Action support
entry.summary: The Irish author said her books can no longer be sold in the UK after she pledged the royalties to a banned pro-Palestinian group.

entry.title: Teen kills 4 at Oregon school. And, DOJ sues California over alleged noncitizens
entry.summary: A teen opened fire at an Oregon elementary school, leaving three kids and one teacher dead. And, the Justice Department is suing California over alleged noncitizen voters.

entry.title: What this bankruptcy says about AI startups
entry.summary: Character.AI collected millions of users, making it a very appealing acquisition. Google took a unique route to "acquiring" it, hiring away its founders and licensing its technology. Now Character.AI is filing for bankruptcy. Here's what to know.

entry.title: 'Everything got worse': Gen Z express frustration, regret after Trump vote
entry.summary: A focus group of eight Gen Z Trump voters reported feeling unhappy or disappointed with the state of politics, with some going as far as to say they regret supporting him in 2024.

entry.title: Remembering Oscar-winning actor Eva Marie Saint
entry.summary: Saint, who died Oct. 6, studied at the Actors Studio and was best known for her roles in On the Waterfront and the Hitchcock film North by Northwest. Originally broadcast in 2000.

entry.title: How much money has Musk given to Republican groups since July? The quiz knows
entry.summary: Plus, this week saw comings and goings at the White House, the revenge of a child (reality) star, and Elon Musk doing Elon Musk things.

entry.title: Do Americans own the president's papers? Appeals court to weigh in
entry.summary: The administration says papers created in the White House belong to Donald Trump, not to the American people. The case could ultimately end up at the conservative-leaning Supreme Court.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Three children and a teacher were killed in a shooting at an Oregon school, how Russia is viewing Ukraine's strikes and its growing rift with the U.S., DOJ sues California over its voter rolls.

entry.title: Public health nurse talks about the moment she learned to ask for help
entry.summary: For StoryCorps, a public health nurse in Minnesota speaks with her college mentor about a moment when she almost gave up on her career aspirations.

entry.title: A rare family of barn owls moved into Manhattan's Upper West Side. New Yorkers are captivated
entry.summary: Manhattan's Upper West Side has been reveling in the company of its latest celebrities: A family of barn owls nested in a water tower atop a building near Central Park.
